author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sapping Mist
summary: A mist that drains strength from creatures breathing it.

stats.effect: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of mist spreads from a point within range. A creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw at the start of its turn, taking 4d6 Necrotic damage and gaining a level of Exhaustion on a failure, or half damage and no Exhaustion on a success.
